Instrument Catalog

The Riverside Observatory operates nine instruments across two domes. Spectrographs are shared between the 1.2m and 0.6m telescopes; imaging cameras are dome-specific and cannot be relocated during a run.

Ritchey-Chretien 1.2m

Primary research telescope. Equatorial fork mount, f/8 focal ratio, autoguided to 0.3 arcsec RMS.

$420 per night telescope

Echelle Spectrograph

Fibre-fed echelle covering 380 to 900 nanometres at resolving power 48000. Thermally stabilised enclosure.

$610 per night spectrograph

Wide Field CMOS Camera

Back-illuminated CMOS sensor, 61 megapixel, 2.2 degree field of view on the 0.6m astrograph.

$185 per night camera

Dual Beam Polarimeter

Measures linear polarisation to 0.01 percent on targets brighter than magnitude 12.

$275 per night polarimeter

Booking policy

Weather cancellations are refunded in full when the dome does not open. Partial nights are billed pro rata against the hours actually observed. Cancellations inside 48 hours forfeit the deposit.
